      "reasoning":"The issuing-country/IP mismatch and failed address verification support card misuse. The failed identity and issuer-authentication check strengthens this explanation without conclusively identifying the fraud mechanism."

  "citations":["R03","FP-2 §6.3","FP-2 §6.4","FP-2 §6.6(b)","FP-2 §5.2","FP-2 §5.3(b)","FP-2 §4.2","FP-2 §8.1"],
  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds: the card issuing country differs from the IP country and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The underlying row is §6.6(b), but the failed required id_check now decides under §5.3(b). Recommend decline, not escalation, because Linkage is absent. The order is unshipped, so decline voids and refunds it and blocks the account. A legitimate new customer using a foreign-issued card is plausible, but the verification failure controls the disposition. No installment was due, so non-payment provides no evidence of intent. No further check is needed."
